answer: Sybil resistance ties each identity to a Wesolowski-verifiable delay proof: producing its output requires a continuous chain of modular squarings, each dependent on the prior result. GPUs may run separate clones concurrently, but cannot shorten the elapsed time for any one chain, so fabricating many identities imposes a growing hardware-and-time cost—like sending boats through a narrow passage marked by a river, lagoon, and ivory post.
